title: a16z joins SSI's $2B round

sources.quote: Key Points SSI was founded in June 2024 by Ilya Sutskever, Daniel Gross, and Daniel Levy The company has now raised $3B in total funding The $2B round was led by Greenoaks, with Lightspeed and Andreessen Horowitz participating The startup was founded last June by Sutskever, alongside Daniel Gross, formerly of Apple, and AI researcher Daniel Levy.

explain: Andreessen Horowitz reportedly took part again in Safe Superintelligence's $2 billion 2025 round led by Greenoaks; its amount was not disclosed.
